findings.finding: RAGTruth/finance/HalluRAG model-file records contain7/11/13 files; all common hashes match. Finance and HalluRAG share the same recorded four weight-shard hashes. RAGTruth has no recorded weight-shard hashes.
findings.identified_implication: File-set-ID differences are explained by recorded membership/coverage; they do not establish different model weights.
findings.limit: RAGTruth original GPU weight identity remains unauthenticated, as its own plan explicitly states.

findings.finding: Finance recorded model/source/observer hashes exactly match retained Git commit be1b8a3. Its BF16 source-present full pass uses eager; prefill/local/source-absent paths use SDPA. HalluRAG native plan explicitly declares matched_sdpa.
findings.identified_implication: The same recorded checkpoint was observed through different execution paths in finance versus HalluRAG.
findings.limit: No same-input paired backend observation is present here, so the contribution of this change to any AUROC difference is unidentified.

findings.finding: All900 RAGTruth Data2txt sources parse as Python dict literals and none as strict JSON, while every prompt describes the source as JSON. Every FRED test reference contains nested-array text embedded in prose.
findings.identified_implication: The observer receives different serialization conventions; a structured-data instruction is not evidence of strict-JSON input.
findings.limit: No format-only counterfactual has been measured.

findings.finding: Digit-bearing valid-token fractions are2.85%,1.89%,2.18%,19.69%,19.85%,4.89% for RAG QA/Summary/Data2txt, FRED FinQA/TATQA and HalluRAG primary. FRED median answers are shorter, but scorer-unit p90 lengths54/51 exceed RAG36/36/32.
findings.identified_implication: Answer length and the context length within a scoring unit are distinct measured variables; numeric character density is not a semantic error label.
findings.limit: These are input-structure differences, not evidence that length or digits cause the performance gap.

findings.finding: HalluRAG primary is a3-template by1/3/5-chunk crossed table with99 responses in each of nine cells. Each source/article occurs in only one template cell. Every one of567 Llama2 responses starts with whitespace; none of324 Mistral responses does. Other five prepared test sets have zero leading-whitespace responses.
findings.identified_implication: Template and chunk-count totals are balanced, while article content is not paired across formats; leading whitespace is perfectly associated with the released generator-family cohort in this cache.
findings.limit: This does not identify a causal whitespace, quantization or template effect. The whitespace origin could be generation or release/postprocessing; those original traces are absent.

findings.finding: RAG QA retains150 actual questions; HalluRAG primary retains81. FRED has a constant source-only Reference material/Response wrapper; its original generation question and generator are not available in the cached contract. HalluRAG preparation joins original message contents, and the observer wraps the result as one user message.
findings.identified_implication: The retained conditioning information differs; nominal QA task names do not make the observed conditional distributions equal.
findings.limit: No invented FRED question can substitute for the missing original question in an attribution study.

findings.finding: FRED cache labels explicitly describe synthetic/silver edit spans. RAGTruth has released character-error spans. HalluRAG has native sentence judgments projected to overlapping tokens. FRED source IDs are exact reference-text SHA256, rather than verified company/filing identities.
findings.identified_implication: The response-generation, label target and source-clustering units differ across datasets.
findings.limit: Fine character spans, native sentences and scorer units must be reported separately; exact reference disjointness does not establish issuer-level independence.

findings.finding: Numeric density, source-table format, question availability, generation provenance and unit-length tails vary jointly in FRED versus the natural-response corpora.
findings.identified_implication: These contracts provide concrete competing explanations that a cross-dataset claim must separate.
findings.limit: Their individual causal contributions and a guaranteed improvement to AUROC>=0.8 are not identified by the cache audit.

findings.identified_implication: A position-sensitive observation artifact is a testable explanation, alongside genuine content/model effects.
findings.limit: Existing responses must retain their bytes and original token IDs; trimming them now would change the evaluation object and would not establish a correction.

necessary_controlled_interventions.kind: new discriminating observation-interface qualification; not a novel scoring method
necessary_controlled_interventions.question: Does leading whitespace itself alter the same response observation enough to explain first-content false alarms, independently of generator identity?
necessary_controlled_interventions.why_new: The known position counts and the567/324 cohort association are observational. A within-response intervention removes that generator confounding and changes only a declared non-factual prefix.
necessary_controlled_interventions.whole_population: Keep every original HalluRAG response, source, released cohort and unknown position; all1782 remain, with the891 answerable primary population retained separately. Do not select only existing FP/FN cases.
paired_response_variants: Insert exactly one U+0020 at the beginning of every response; factual words and punctuation remain unchanged.
Remove exactly one existing leading U+0020 when present; otherwise retain the identical original as a declared zero-removal control. Other prefix characters remain unchanged.
hold_fixed: existing frozen readout and segmentation rule
source/generator population and original factual character sequence

character_axis.mapping: Map each unchanged original content character to its exact shifted variant offset. Insertion at the front shifts existing spans by+1; removal shifts remaining original characters by-1. The inserted/removed whitespace is separately tracked.
character_axis.tokenization: BPE IDs/counts can change under this intervention, so token index0 is not treated as a comparable semantic position. Record token/character/unit maps and compare the original first content span and full original-content curve.
character_axis.gold: Map existing native-sentence/character spans by the deterministic offset map; retain their semantic labels and unknown status. Do not relabel, delete first tokens, or discard changed-tokenization examples.
character_axis.scope: Character alignment is a diagnostic representation of frozen outputs, not a new weighted detector or a new claim of tokenwise truth.

length_format_matched_control.operation: Add/remove the same number of U+0020 characters at a predeclared non-initial whitespace boundary, preserving the same factual character sequence.
length_format_matched_control.matching: Choose the control boundary by a frozen deterministic tokenizer-only rule, matching character-count and total-token/unit-format changes where feasible; never choose it using risk scores or gold labels.
length_format_matched_control.fallback: If a response lacks such an exact match, preserve it and report the unmatched-control stratum. Whole-population preservation takes precedence over obtaining a convenient matched subset.
length_format_matched_control.purpose: Distinguish a response-onset/generation-to-observer interface effect from generic added-length/whitespace-format effects.

endpoints: Paired source-present and source-absent logp/contrast change at the same original content spans, with special attention to the first original word/phrase.
Existing final readout observations mapped back to the same original content characters; report tokenization and unit-boundary changes as possible mediators.
Contrast the leading-prefix intervention against the length/format-matched interior control, within the same response and then within source/generator cohorts.

Any label-stratified alarm diagnosis uses the already declared budget and common original-content population after all variants and scores freeze; these previously exposed populations remain exploratory.

qualification_decision.supports_interface_explanation: A prefix-specific paired shift beyond matched controls, with factual text/labels unchanged, supports an interface contribution to onset alarms.
qualification_decision.does_not_support: Absent prefix-specific shifts, or shifts explained equally by matched controls, fail to support the leading-whitespace-specific explanation.
qualification_decision.not_claimed: Neither outcome by itself establishes a new detector, justifies trimming original answers, or guarantees six-task AUROC>=0.8.

prohibited_shortcuts: relabeling normal words to fit predictions
recounting known token-position statistics as the result
discarding responses or unknowns to obtain matching
